SELECT u.id, u.msg_id, u.sp_id, u.src_terminal_id, u.dest_id, u.msg_content, u.msg_fmt, u.service_id, u.is_report, u.report_stat, u.channel_code, u.create_time, d.msg_content AS down_msg_content, d.create_time AS down_create_time, c.name AS channel_name, c.host AS channel_host, c.port AS channel_port, c.status AS channel_status FROM ink_sms_up u LEFT JOIN ink_sms_down d ON d.id = ( SELECT d2.id FROM ink_sms_down d2 WHERE d2.dest_terminal_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = u.src_terminal_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND d2.create_time <= u.create_time ORDER BY d2.create_time DESC, d2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN ink_channel c ON c.code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = u.channel_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci WHERE u.id = #{id}
